name: rq6-errors-candidates-dev-errors
description:
RQ6, error analysis of the final-model candidates on development data (python -m
experiments errors): the XLM-R token classifier with WikiGoldSK and SlavicNER added,
which leads on UNER-SK (0.961) but stays at 0.89 on REDACT on every seed, against GLiNER
focal loss with the same data and with the real corpora 3x, which keep 0.94 there.
Counts what kind of names each misses and wrongly flags, three seeds each. Reads the
prediction cache rq6-candidates-dev fills; run after it.

misses.all: every gold span of the type
misses.title: a title or honorific directly before it or as its first word
misses.sentence_start: starts its line or a sentence
misses.after_label: the value of a 'Label: value' line
misses.hyphen_apostrophe: holds a hyphen, dash or apostrophe

false_alarms.all: every false alarm of the type
false_alarms.capitalised_word: one capitalised word, not all capitals
false_alarms.title: a title or honorific directly before it or as its first word
false_alarms.sentence_start: starts its line or a sentence
false_alarms.after_label: the value of a 'Label: value' line
false_alarms.other_type: overlaps a gold span of another type
